name: Furen's Notes
summary: Furen's Notes carry his discoveries in metallurgy and armorsmithing from Stormwind to Alliance craftsmen. After forging protective gear for veteran warriors, Furen Longbeard sends copies to help fellow smiths refine their work.

sections.title: A Master's Discoveries
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Furen Longbeard forges specialized armaments for warriors and records the methods and discoveries he makes along the way. Dwarven metalworking keeps changing, so he makes several copies for other smiths to use and build upon. His notes describe practical ways to temper, reinforce, and shape armor against deadly blows.

sections.title: Dispatched Across the Alliance
sections.body: Furen sends copies to trusted contacts in the Alliance's crafting networks. Grimand Elmore may scoff at a fellow smith he claims to have taught, but the notes still hold useful insights. Copies cross the Great Sea to night elven craftsmen, including Mathiel on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. Shared needs in battle bring their different traditions into contact.

faq.q: What is contained within Furen's Notes?
faq.answer: Furen's Notes contain descriptions of armorsmithing techniques and discoveries in metallurgy that Furen Longbeard developed while making custom armor for seasoned warriors.
Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District. He guides rising warriors and makes specialized defensive wargear.

faq.q: Why does Grimand Elmore get angry about the notes?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore claims he taught Furen everything the dwarf knows, and resents the suggestion that his former student can teach him something new. Still, Grimand admits the notes describe techniques worth trying.

faq.q: Who receives copies of Furen's Notes?
faq.answer: Furen sends copies to trusted colleagues across the Alliance, including weapon smith Grimand Elmore in Stormwind, night elven smith Mathiel in Darnassus, and gnomish blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

faq.q: How does Mathiel react to the notes?
faq.answer: Mathiel, a night elf blacksmith on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, welcomes Furen's findings with enthusiasm. He sees them as a grand discovery and an honor to bring into his own work.

angles.text: As a warrior, your armor trials in Stormwind lead directly to these notes. They record practical ideas shaped by the needs of frontline combat.
As a blacksmith, you see the exchange of specialized armorcrafting knowledge among dwarven, elven, and gnomish artisans across the Alliance.
